Zoe C.: Heads-up: Newbridge sent a combined vendor questionnaire + DPA amendment request. Key asks: explicit deletion attestation for embeddings, confirmation of regional residency, and whether BYOK is available on Hosted. They want a single PDF packet by next Tue.
Rafael - Security: I can cover the crypto + residency notes. Short answers: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit. Hosted tenants default to regional storage for hot tier; cold-tier may be optimized cross-region unless we opt in to region-lock.
Imani (Legal): If they want contract-level attestation we should prepare an addendum template. Who signs attestation PDFs typically? Legal or CS?
Kim AE: Legal-signed attestation is preferred by procurement. They treat that as an executable deliverable for renewal.
Caleb Onboard: Uploading the questionnaire and current subprocessor list to the account folder now: https://files.redwood/newbridge/q2-vendor.pdf
notify-bot: Ticket created: CS-4127 "Newbridge: DPA + embeddings attestation" assigned to Zoe C., due 2024-07-09.
Zoe C.: Action plan: Rafael 1: sample audit log + residency wording; Imani 1: DPA attestation draft; Caleb 1: one-page data lifecycle and retention flow for embeddings; Kim 1: migration/BYOK cost + timeline if they insist. Assemble single PDF and review.
Rafael - Security: Sample audit log snippet to include (we'll sanitize):
```
DELETE_JOB acct=newbridge-88 id=del_20240702_022 status=completed items=142 ts=2024-07-02T02:12:03Z
```
Also: BYOK on Hosted is not available by default. If customer requires BYOK for embedding encryption we suggest Dedicated or a managed BYOK migration; details in packet.
Imani (Legal): Drafting attestation text: "Redwood confirms execution of deletion workflow and will provide audit evidence (job IDs and timestamps). Full purge completes within 30 days of account termination unless otherwise agreed in writing." Posting draft to ticket for comments.
Caleb Onboard: Data lifecycle one-pager draft uploaded. It covers ingest -> storage (hot/cold) -> tagging -> deletion workflow -> audit evidence. Notes manual region-lock process and expected lead time (48-72 hrs) and potential TCO impact.
Kim AE: Migration/BYOK ballpark: Dedicated onboarding + BYOK integration ~ 3-5 weeks; expect infra uplift and project fees. I'll add numbers to the packet.
Zoe C.: We'll do a team review tomorrow 9am PT. Please post any blockers here before then. The customer asked for a single-signed PDF; Imani, can Legal sign the final attestation?
Imani (Legal): Yes, Legal can sign. I'll prepare the PDF-ready attestation and mark it for signature after review.
Rafael - Security: Uploaded the technical snippets and sample log to CS-4127. Also added a short note on how pseudonymization can be done client-side before embedding.
notify-bot: Reminder: CS-4127 review scheduled 2024-07-03 09:00 PT.
Zoe C.: Thanks team. We'll combine into one packet and run a quick 30-min review before sending. If Newbridge pushes the timeline earlier, we'll escalate to Sales + Solutions. :white_check_mark:
